newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products - fuel dips, gas oil flat.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - fuel dips, gas oil flat.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday, gas oil broadly unchanged, while fuel oil barges softened, dealers said.

High sulphur fuel oil barges were down by $2 a tonne from Monday's close, trading at $81.50 fob Antwerp and fob Rotterdam. Traders said Tuesday's dip was a reaction to continued poor demand, adding the slight recovery on Monday was the result more of raised offers than better buying. "It's become softer as the sellers are forced to come down," said one.
Heating oil barges were unchanged. Offers for prompt product held at around May IPE +75 cents/$1 fob Rotterdam.
